import sys

lines = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
if len(lines) < 2:
    sys.exit(0)

S = lines[0]
T = lines[1]

ans = "YES"
j = 0
for i in range(len(T) - 1, -1, -1):
    if j >= len(S) or T[i] != S[j]:
        ans = "NO"
        break
    j += 1

print(ans)
